answer: By modeling trust propagation as a diffusion process, we establish that the spectral partition barrier restricts malicious flow; the adversarial trust plume cannot cross the sparse cut into the honest ocean of nodes. Personalized EigenTrust matrices attenuate this spread, acting like a chemical pigment that isolates Sybil clusters. To guarantee a robust Nash equilibrium, we enforce zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions and high staking collateral, where automatic slashing penalties render the expected utility of any Sybil attack strictly negative.
